module_summary: Source half of a two-phase CDC: on valid/ready accept it toggles a request register and latches data, ready when synchronized ack phase matches request.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Source-side valid; with ready_o forms src_accept to launch a transfer.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Ready when request phase equals synchronized ack phase (no transfer in flight).

anchors.name: async_req_o
anchors.why: Two-phase request toggle driven by req_src_q toward destination domain.

anchors.name: async_ack_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous two-phase ack from destination, synchronized by tc_sync.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Data held stable in data_src_q crossing to destination domain.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Source data payload latched into data_src_q on accept.

anchors.name: src_accept
anchors.why: Load enable toggling req_src_q and capturing data_src_q.

anchors.name: ack_synced
anchors.why: Synchronized ack phase compared with req_src_q to produce ready_o.

groups.name: Two-phase request/ack control
groups.description: Toggle request register and ack synchronizer deciding source readiness.

groups.name: CDC data holding
groups.description: data_src_q holds payload stable while request is outstanding.
